title: Mag 7? MANGOS? SpaceX forces name rethink on Wall Street's tech-stock moniker
title_zh: 7级？芒果？ SpaceX 迫使华尔街重新考虑科技股的名称
summary: SpaceX roared into markets this past week with a valuation of more than $2 trillion, surpassing two members of Wall Street's "Magnificent Seven" and raising a key question: Does the Mag 7 name still fit? ‌And if not, what should replace it? The IPO, the biggest in U.S.
summary_zh: SpaceX 上周以超过 2 万亿美元的估值冲进市场，超越了华尔街“七巨头”的两名成员，并提出了一个关键问题：Mag 7 这个名字还合适吗？ ‌如果没有，应该用什么来代替呢？此次IPO是美国规模最大的IPO

title: With smooth SpaceX debut, Wall Street sets new template for mega IPOs
title_zh: 随着 SpaceX 顺利上市，华尔街为大型 IPO 树立了新模板
summary: By Anirban Sen, Nivedita Balu and Saeed Azhar NEW YORK, June 12 (Reuters) - A collective sigh of relief swept across Wall Street after trading for SpaceX’s landmark Nasdaq launch went smoothly,
summary_zh: 作者：Anirban Sen、Nivedita Balu 和 Saeed Azhar 纽约，6 月 12 日（路透社）——在 SpaceX 具有里程碑意义的纳斯达克发射交易顺利进行后，整个华尔街集体松了一口气。

title: Exclusive-Tata's iPhone parts factory contaminated farmland water, India pollution body alleges
title_zh: 独家-印度污染机构称塔塔iPhone零部件工厂污染农田水
summary: An Indian pollution regulator has alleged wastewater discharged from a Tata components factory for Apple's iPhone has contaminated the groundwater for nearby farms and warned of a ‌forced shutdown unless Tata gives a satisfactory explanation.
summary_zh: 印度污染监管机构称，苹果 iPhone 的塔塔零部件工厂排放的废水污染了附近农场的地下水，并警告除非塔塔给出令人满意的解释，否则将被迫关闭。

title: Wall Street ends higher as SpaceX's market debut dominates
title_zh: SpaceX 首次亮相，华尔街股市收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Friday, as SpaceX shares surged in their debut, making it Wall Street's biggest public listing in history.The Dow jumped seven-tenths of a percent, the S&P 500 added half a percent and the Nasdaq gained just under a third of a ...
summary_zh: 故事：周五，华尔街主要股指收高，SpaceX 股价首次亮相，股价飙升，成为华尔街历史上规模最大的公开上市。道琼斯指数上涨十分之七，标准普尔 500 指数上涨半个百分点，纳斯达克指数上涨近三分之一......

summary_zh: 故事：埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 在周五的首次公开募股中上涨了 19%，全球有史以来规模最大的 IPO 结束，投资者纷纷涌入这家火箭公司，押注于其现在亿万富翁的首席执行官 [击败] 以及将人工智能送入太空的前景。周五的首次亮相为 SpaceX 带...

title: Paramount’s Deal for Warner Bros. Is Cleared by US DOJ
title_zh: 派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟的交易获得美国司法部批准
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The US Justice Department has closed an antitrust probe into Paramount Skydance Corp.’s $110 billion purchase of Warner Bros.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国司法部已结束对派拉蒙 Skydance Corp. 以 1100 亿美元收购华纳兄弟的反垄断调查。

title: AI trade is 'fantastic right now' and 'something you have to be in': Analyst
title_zh: 分析师：人工智能贸易“现在非常棒”并且“是你必须参与的领域”
summary: StockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip shares her perspective on the AI trade is broadening on newer innovations.
summary_zh: StockBrokers.com 投资者研究总监 Jessica Inskip 分享了她对人工智能行业的看法正在拓宽新的创新。

title: SpaceX closes nearly 20% higher on first trading day post-IPO
title_zh: SpaceX IPO后第一个交易日收盘上涨近20%
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) inch higher to end Friday's session and the trading week with slight gains, as SpaceX (SPCX) closes its first day of trading 19.22% higher at a share price of $160.95.
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）小幅上涨，以小幅上涨结束周五交易日和交易周，SpaceX (SPCX) 首日交易收盘上涨 19.22%，股价为 160.95 美元。
